title: Comparative adjectives
grammarNote:
Сравнительная степень (Comparative) — используется для сравнения ДВУХ вещей.
Превосходная степень (Superlative) — говорит о том, что что-то является самым/наибольшим/наименьшим СРЕДИ ВСЕХ.

📐 КАК ОБРАЗОВАТЬ СРАВНИТЕЛЬНУЮ СТЕПЕНЬ:

① Короткие прилагательные (1–2 слога) → + ER + THAN:
cold → COLDER THAN · warm → WARMER THAN · hot → HOTTER THAN
old → OLDER THAN · long → LONGER THAN · thick → THICKER THAN
"Saturday is COLDER THAN today." · "The coat is WARMER THAN the jacket."

② Длинные прилагательные (3+ слога) → MORE + adj + THAN:
comfortable → MORE COMFORTABLE THAN
waterproof → MORE WATERPROOF THAN
practical → MORE PRACTICAL THAN
"This coat is MORE COMFORTABLE THAN that one."
"Wool is MORE PRACTICAL THAN cotton in winter."

📐 КАК ОБРАЗОВАТЬ ПРЕВОСХОДНУЮ СТЕПЕНЬ:

① Короткие: THE + adj + EST:
cold → THE COLDEST · warm → THE WARMEST · long → THE LONGEST
"Astana is THE COLDEST capital in the world."
"January is THE COLDEST month in Kazakhstan."

② Длинные: THE MOST + adj:
comfortable → THE MOST COMFORTABLE · expensive → THE MOST EXPENSIVE
"This is THE MOST COMFORTABLE coat I have ever worn."

⚠️ ПРАВИЛА НАПИСАНИЯ (сравнительная степень):

▸ Прилагательное заканчивается на -e → просто + r/st:
nice → nicer → nicest · large → larger → largest

▸ Прилагательное CVC (согласная-гласная-согласная, 1 слог) → двойная согласная:
hot → HOT-TER → hottest · big → BIG-GER → biggest · thin → THIN-NER → thinnest
wet → WET-TER → wettest · slim → SLIM-MER → slimmest

▸ Прилагательное заканчивается на -y → -y меняется на -ier/-iest:
heavy → HEAVIER → heaviest · windy → WINDIER → windiest
cloudy → CLOUDIER → cloudiest · cosy → COSIER → cosiest

🔴 ИСКЛЮЧЕНИЯ (неправильные формы — нужно запомнить!):
good → BETTER → the best
bad → WORSE → the worst
far → FURTHER → the furthest
much/many → MORE → the most
little → LESS → the least

💪 КАК УСИЛИТЬ ИЛИ СМЯГЧИТЬ СРАВНЕНИЕ:
"MUCH colder than" (намного холоднее) — большая разница
"A BIT / SLIGHTLY colder than" (чуть холоднее) — маленькая разница
"FAR colder than" (значительно холоднее) — подчёркивает разницу
"NOT AS cold AS" (не такой холодный как) — они почти одинаковые или отличаются

"Uralsk is MUCH warmer than Astana in winter." (намного теплее)
"Saturday is SLIGHTLY colder than today." (чуть-чуть холоднее)
"Uralsk is NOT AS cold AS Astana in winter." (менее холодный)

📌 THAN — обязательный элемент при сравнении двух вещей:
✅ "Saturday is colder THAN today."
❌ "Saturday is colder as today." — только THAN, не AS!

grammarExtra.title: ① Сравнительная степень: короткие и длинные прилагательные

rows.example: "Saturday is COLDER THAN today." · "The wool scarf is WARMER THAN the cotton one." · "Uralsk is MILDER THAN Astana."
"Wool is MORE COMFORTABLE THAN synthetic fabric." · "This coat is MORE EXPENSIVE THAN that jacket." · "Spring is MORE PLEASANT THAN winter."
simple: "simpler" (+ er) · careful: "more careful" (more +) · quiet: "quieter" (+er) · extreme: "more extreme" (more +)
"colder THAN" · "more comfortable THAN" ✅ — ❌ "colder as" — неправильно! Всегда THAN, не AS!
"Astana is COLDER THAN Uralsk in winter." · "Uralsk is MILDER THAN Astana — but still COLDER THAN most cities."
"Saturday is COLDER THAN today." · "Sunday is BETTER THAN Saturday." · "The wool coat is WARMER THAN the jacket."
hot → HOT-TER (tt!) · big → BIG-GER (gg!) · thin → THIN-NER (nn!) · wet → WET-TER · slim → SLIM-MER

rows.form: ⚠️ CVC проверка: 1 слог + заканчивается на согласную:
rows.example: hot = h-o-t (CVC ✅) → hotter · warm = w-a-r-m (CVCC — две согласных!) → warmer (без удвоения)
windy → windIER · cloudy → cloudIER · heavy → heavIER · cosy → cosIER · foggy → foggIER
cloudy: d-y → cloudier ✅ · grey: e-y → greyER ✅ (не "greier"!) — буква y после гласной → просто + er
nice → nicER · large → largER · pale → palER (НЕ "niceer", "largeer") · strange → strangER
hot (Uralsk summer) → HOTTER · thin (Gulnara's jacket) → THINNER · heavy (October sky) → HEAVIER
THE COLDEST month · THE WARMEST coat · THE THICKEST scarf · THE LONGEST winter · THE HOTTEST summer
THE MOST COMFORTABLE coat · THE MOST WATERPROOF jacket · THE MOST PRACTICAL choice · THE MOST STYLISH outfit
good → BETTER → THE BEST · bad → WORSE → THE WORST · far → FURTHER → THE FURTHEST · much → MORE → THE MOST
"January is THE COLDEST month in Uralsk." · "This is THE BEST coat I have ever bought." · "The fog was THE WORST on Tuesday."
"Astana is ONE OF THE COLDEST capital cities in the world." — очень частая конструкция в описаниях.
"Saturday morning is THE COLDEST part of the day." · "My warmest coat" = "THE WARMEST coat I have" = THE BEST for winter.

grammarExtra.title: ④ Усиление и смягчение сравнения: much / a bit / not as...as

rows.example: "Astana is MUCH COLDER than Uralsk." · "Sunday is MUCH BETTER than Saturday." · "Wool is MUCH WARMER than cotton."
"Saturday is A BIT COLDER than today." · "This coat is SLIGHTLY THICKER than the other one." · "Spring is SLIGHTLY WARMER."
"Astana is FAR COLDER than most European cities." · "This coat is FAR MORE COMFORTABLE than my old one."

rows.form: NOT AS + adj + AS (не такой... как):
rows.example: "Uralsk is NOT AS COLD AS Astana." (= Uralsk менее холодный) · "The jacket is NOT AS WARM AS the coat."

rows.form: JUST AS + adj + AS (такой же... как):
rows.example: "The paperback is JUST AS USEFUL AS the hardcover." · "Spring in Uralsk is JUST AS BEAUTIFUL AS in Astana."
"Uralsk in winter is NOT AS EXTREME AS Astana." · "Saturday is SLIGHTLY COLDER THAN today." · "Sunday is MUCH BETTER THAN Saturday."

grammarTip:
Четыре шага — и сравнительная степень всегда правильная:

① Посчитай слоги:
   1–2 слога → + ER: cold → COLDER · warm → WARMER
   3+ слога → MORE +: comfortable → MORE COMFORTABLE

② Проверь на ловушки:
   CVC (1 слог, -согл.) → удвоение: hot → HOTT-ER
   -y → -ier: windy → WIND-IER
   -e в конце → только + r: nice → NIC-ER

③ Добавь THAN (всегда!):
   "colder THAN" ✅ · "more comfortable THAN" ✅
   ❌ "colder as" — только THAN!

④ Исключения — знай наизусть:
   good → BETTER · bad → WORSE · far → FURTHER

💡 Запомни из наших уроков:
   "Astana is MUCH COLDER THAN Uralsk."
   "Saturday is SLIGHTLY COLDER THAN today."
   "Sunday is MUCH BETTER THAN Saturday."
   "Uralsk is NOT AS EXTREME AS Astana."
   "January is THE COLDEST month of the year."

exercises.text: November in Uralsk is ___ than September.
exercises.hint: cold = 1 syllable → comparative: cold + ER = COLDER. "November is COLDER THAN September." ✅ Never "more cold" for short adjectives!

exercises.text: A wool coat is ___ (comfortable) than a thin synthetic jacket for winter.
exercises.hint: comfortable = 4 syllables → MORE comfortable THAN. ✅ Long adjectives use MORE, not -ER. "MORE COMFORTABLE THAN" — never "comfortabler"!

exercises.text: "Saturday is colder as today" is correct English.
exercises.hint: FALSE! After a comparative adjective, always use THAN — never AS. ✅ "Saturday is colder THAN today." ❌ "colder AS" is wrong in English.

exercises.text: What is the correct comparative form of "hot"?
exercises.hint: hot = CVC (h-o-t): consonant-vowel-consonant, 1 syllable → DOUBLE the final consonant + er: hot → HOTT-ER. ✅ "hoter" is wrong — must double the t!

exercises.instruction: Write the correct comparative or superlative.
exercises.text: Of all the months, January is ___ (cold) in Uralsk.
exercises.hint: Superlative (among ALL months) → THE + short adj + EST: cold → THE COLDEST. "January is THE COLDEST month." ✅ Use THE + -est for superlative.

exercises.text: Today it's zero degrees. Sunday will be minus two. Which sentence is correct?
opts: Sunday will be more cold than today.
Sunday will be colder than today.
Sunday will be coldest than today.
Sunday will be the colder than today.
exercises.correct: Sunday will be colder than today.
exercises.hint: cold = short adj → colder. Comparing TWO things (Sunday vs today) = comparative, not superlative. "Sunday will be COLDER THAN today." ✅

exercises.text: "Astana is much colder than Uralsk" means Astana and Uralsk have almost the same temperature.
exercises.hint: "MUCH colder" = намного холоднее — a BIG difference! "A BIT colder" = маленькая разница. "Much" before a comparative = very large difference. Astana is significantly colder!

opts: Uralsk is not as cold as Astana.
Uralsk is not cold as Astana.
Uralsk is not as cold than Astana.
Uralsk is not colder as Astana.
exercises.correct: Uralsk is not as cold as Astana.
exercises.hint: "NOT AS + adjective + AS" — both "as" are required! "Uralsk is not AS cold AS Astana." ✅ Means: Uralsk is less cold than Astana. Both AS must be present.
